note: Prices for buying points, by programme id (the ids the seat data uses). price_kind 'listed' means the figure was read from the programme's own page (or its text as shown by a search); 'guide' means it comes from a published guide or from a related programme and is shown as a rough guide only. A programme with no figure sends the member to its own site. Prices change often and promotions beat them. source_url is only ever an exact page a researcher read or a search result showed.

virgin-flyingclub.name: Virgin Atlantic Flying Club
virgin-flyingclub.note: Plus a one-off fee of $22 per purchase (the page says £15/$25 per 1,000 points and £15/$22 per transaction).
virgin-flyingclub.source: Virgin Atlantic's own page, read directly

turkish-ms.name: Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles
turkish-ms.note: Includes VAT, minimum 1,000 miles. You must be signed in to buy.
turkish-ms.source: Turkish Airlines' page, from a search summary

emirates-skywards.name: Emirates Skywards
emirates-skywards.note: The cap is 100,000 a year for Blue and Silver and 200,000 for Gold and Platinum, buying and gifting together. Some country pages differ: check yours.
emirates-skywards.source: Emirates' page, from a search summary

aeroplan.name: Air Canada Aeroplan
aeroplan.note: Before taxes, minimum 2,000 points, usually up to 250,000 a transaction. Sign in to Aeroplan and look for Buy points.

atmos-rewards.name: Alaska Atmos Rewards
atmos-rewards.note: $35 per 1,000 plus 7.5% US federal tax. The 150,000 a year cap is for members without elite status.

american-airlines-aadvantage.name: American AAdvantage
american-airlines-aadvantage.note: 2,000 miles cost $75.25 including tax. The cap includes miles you gift.

united-mileageplus.name: United MileagePlus
united-mileageplus.note: About 3.76 cents a mile including tax at the base price, with frequent promotions. The cap is 50,000 per 90 days and 200,000 a year.

delta-skymiles.name: Delta SkyMiles
delta-skymiles.note: Guides disagree between 3.5 and 3.76 cents a mile; the higher figure is used so the estimate is not too low. The yearly cap is for your own account and is raised during promotions.

qatar-privilege-club.name: Qatar Airways Privilege Club
qatar-privilege-club.note: Rough guide only. Qatar sells Avios inside your Privilege Club account (look for Buy Avios) and publishes no price for India. The figure shown is British Airways' price for India-registered accounts in July 2025 (₹1.46 per Avios at the lowest tier). Qatar's own price may differ, so open your account to see it.
qatar-privilege-club.source: Live From A Lounge on British Airways' India price, July 2025

ba-executive-club.name: British Airways Executive Club
ba-executive-club.note: Rough guide only. Sold inside your Executive Club account (Buy Avios). For India-registered accounts one blog reported ₹1.46 per Avios at the lowest tier in July 2025; the price falls with volume and changes with promotions.

finnair-plus.name: Finnair Plus
finnair-plus.note: Rough guide only. Sold inside your Finnair Plus account (Buy Avios) in your account's currency, with regular sales. The figure shown is British Airways' India price for Avios in July 2025; Finnair's own price may differ.
finnair-plus.source: The Milelion on Finnair sales, and Live From A Lounge on British Airways' India price

iberia-club.name: Iberia Plus
iberia-club.note: Rough guide only. Sold inside your Iberia Plus account (Buy Avios). The figure shown is British Airways' India price for Avios in July 2025; Iberia's own regular price can be higher.
iberia-club.source: LoyaltyLobby and Traveling For Miles, and Live From A Lounge on British Airways' India price

krisflyer.name: Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer
krisflyer.note: About US$0.04 a mile according to a guide and a snippet of KrisFlyer's terms. We could not open the official page, so check the price when you sign in and buy.
krisflyer.source: Blog guide and a search snippet of KrisFlyer terms

flying-blue.name: Air France-KLM Flying Blue
flying-blue.note: Sold inside your Flying Blue account. The 100,000 a year cap is for members without elite status.

etihad-guest.name: Etihad Guest
etihad-guest.note: About 3.2 cents a mile for small purchases in a 2025 report. Etihad's own pages give conflicting yearly caps (100,000 or 200,000), so check yours.
etihad-guest.source: A 2025 report on Etihad's price (page not opened)

qantas-ff.name: Qantas Frequent Flyer
qantas-ff.note: The price falls as you buy more: about A$56 per 1,000 for 1,000 points, A$38.80 per 1,000 at 10,000 and A$26.60 per 1,000 at 150,000. The 10,000 level is used here. Up to 4 purchases in 12 months.

velocity.name: Virgin Australia Velocity
velocity.note: The price falls as you buy more: A$36 for 1,000 points and about A$23.40 per 1,000 at 50,000. The higher price is used so the estimate is not too low.

lifemiles.name: Avianca LifeMiles
lifemiles.note: About US$0.033 a mile outside promotions. Guides disagree on the yearly cap (150,000 to over 500,000), so check yours.

saudia-alfursan.name: Saudia Alfursan
saudia-alfursan.note: SAR 112.5 (about US$30) per 1,000 miles before any bonus. Look for Buy miles when signed in.
saudia-alfursan.source: One Mile at a Time, September 2026 promotion

cathay-asiamiles.name: Cathay Asia Miles
cathay-asiamiles.note: About US$60 per 2,000 miles. Cathay sells miles only at the checkout of a reward booking, in blocks of 2,000, and you need at least 70% of the miles already.

infinity-mileagelands.name: EVA Air Infinity MileageLands
infinity-mileagelands.note: EVA sells miles in blocks of 1,000, up to 150,000 a year, and bought miles can cover at most half of a redemption. No standard price found.

miles-and-more.name: Lufthansa Miles & More
miles-and-more.note: Sold in bundles in euros (for example 15,000 miles for €250 in a 2025 deal, which included a bonus), so there is no per-mile price to quote. Open the page to see today's bundles.

jal-mileage-bank.name: JAL Mileage Bank
jal-mileage-bank.note: JAL does not sell miles to members.
